svg.text: PG 18.3 vs pg_duckdb v1.2.2 vs pg_yaap
Identical PostgreSQL 18.3 server (UTF8 tpch, 4GB shared_buffers, 12 parallel workers, worker AIO, 30s statement_timeout).
0s to 30s, 5s major ticks · right-hand badges show slowest/fastest multiplier (worst ÷ best; timeout = 30s)
Right-hand labels show multiplier = slowest_time / fastest_time (timeout = 30s when a query timed out); pill color indicates fastest engine.
All 3 engines ran interleaved after 1 warmup sweep on identical PG 18.3 server GUCs; pg_yaap matches pg_duckdb (22/22) and PG (19/19).
